name: agentguards-claude-selfhosted
description: LLM security guardrails for Claude Code, for a self-hosted AgentGuards appliance — jailbreak detection, prompt-injection and web-content scanning, data-exfiltration blocking, and destructive-command authorization, enforced entirely by hooks. No bundled MCP server: Claude Code's .mcp.json cannot point at a per-installation URL, so a shared one would silently talk to AgentGuards' SaaS instead of your appliance. Use agentguards-claude instead if you're on the hosted product.

agentguards_api_key.title: AgentGuards API key
agentguards_api_key.description: Your AgentGuards token, starting with ag_. Get it from https://agentguards.co/dashboard/keys — the guardrails cannot screen anything without it.

agentguards_url.title: AgentGuards appliance URL
agentguards_url.description: The https:// address of your self-hosted AgentGuards appliance, e.g. https://agentguards.internal. There is deliberately no default: this plugin must never fall back to the hosted service.
